sources.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight Multimodal Decision Models
sources.snippet: Liquid AI has announced the release of two new open-weight multimodal decision models, d1-3B and d1-omni-600M, as part of its d1 decision model family. These models are designed to process both text and images, as well as text with audio, while uniquely operating without generating text output.

sources.title: Decision Models - docs.liquid.ai
sources.snippet: Decision models are a new class of AI model purpose-built for structured decisions. Instead of generating text token by token, a decision model evaluates a situation and returns calibrated probabilities across a fixed set of outcomes in a single call with zero generated tokens.
